verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a testing capability to simulate test purchases before going live, which implies a non-production test environment for the integration. The evidence never explicitly describes a separate sandbox or how it isolates production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test-mode environment isolated from live data, details of what can be simulated (authorizations, webhooks, card lifecycle), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
